newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil up with futures, premiums touch easier.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil up with futures, premiums touch easier.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were steady to narrowly weaker on Thursday, but outright prices surged higher on the back of stronger IPE futures.
February IPE gas oil was $4 stronger at $208.50 a tonne on the back of bullish US distillate inventory data and colder forecasts in the US northeast.
Barge premiums in ARA were 25 to 50 cents stronger at Feb IPE +$2.50/+$3.25, with second half February steady at Feb IPE +$1/+$2, but business was very slow.
"Not a lot is being done, demand is pretty thin," said one barge trader.
A storage material barge was done at Feb IPE +$3.50 fob Rotterdam for delivery this weekend, the price reflecting the prompt loading date.
Cargoes were slow on Thursday and premiums eased a shade in response to the strong futures. Heating oil premiums were about 50 cents down at Feb IPE $5.50-6.50 cif NWE.
Diesel cargo premiums were steady despite thin interest.
"There is not much being offered at the moment and people are looking at March with talk around (Mar IPE) +$18," said one trader.
